2026-10-30TCCanada Marine ActRegulations Amending the Port Authorities Operations Regulations (Miscellaneous Program)Regulations Amending the Port Authorities Operations Regulations (Miscellaneous Program) in order to make a number of amendments to the Regulation to address concerns raised by the Standing Joint Committee for the Scrutiny of Regulations such as (1) clarifying the terms used to ensure they are aligned with what is permitted and correcting the inconsistency between the English and French versions; and (2) replace all references to “Port Metro Vancouver” with the “Port of Vancouver”.Registration: SOR/2026-0230 Publication Date: 2026-11-18
subject: Regulations Amending the Port Authorities Operations Regulations (Miscellaneous Program)
precis: Regulations Amending the Port Authorities Operations Regulations (Miscellaneous Program) in order to make a number of amendments to the Regulation to address concerns raised by the Standing Joint Committee for the Scrutiny of Regulations such as (1) clarifying the terms used to ensure they are aligned with what is permitted and correcting the inconsistency between the English and French versions; and (2) replace all references to “Port Metro Vancouver” with the “Port of Vancouver”.
